We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. It sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution, and is built for someone who leads programs, drives change, and moves ambitious initiatives from plan to measurable outcome. content: ...ora as built specifically for them. You'll take the operating-model narrative for how an AI-first legal team works and adapt it into practice- and segment-specific playbooks: positioning, proof points, and materials that translate our platform's depth into concrete reasons to buy. The sharpness of that translation is what determines whether we win the room or get bucketed alongside every other AI vendor in the market. The ideal candidate has spent the better part of a decade owning solutions or vertical product marketing in high-growth enterprise SaaS or AI environments. They know how to take a single product and shape it into distinct, buyer-specific narratives without fragmenting the brand or diluting the message. They understand how to partner with sales on the deals that matter, how to build the materials that move pipeline, and how to land a launch that holds together across product, sales, and customer-facing teams. They are exceptional writers and storytellers who can turn a generic capability into a specific reason to buy. What You'll Do - Solutions positioning: Own how Legora shows up across our core solutions — drafting, review, research, diligence, knowledge — and translate product depth into clear, defensible positioning for each. - Practice & workflow playbooks: Build the playbooks that win in specific practices and in-house functions — adapting the operating-model narrative into the positioning, proof points, and enablement for each. Partner with our Legal Engineers to ground every playbook in how the work actually gets done, so nothing ships that a practitioner would dismiss. - Segment strategy: Sharpen how we position across segments. Make sure the same product narrative reads unique and relevant to each. - GTM execution: Drive the launch motions, sales narratives, and enablement that turn positioning into pipeline.
